answer.reason: The gospels tell of John's call, his place on the mountain with Jesus, and his request for a seat in Jesus' glory.

clauses.english: left the ship and his father and followed Jesus when called
clauses.quote: immediately left the ship and their father, and followed him

clauses.english: was taken up a high mountain where Jesus was transfigured before him
clauses.quote: Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother

clauses.english: asked to sit at Jesus' right hand in his glory
clauses.quote: Grant unto us that we may sit, one on thy right hand

doubts: 2JN 1:1 and 3JN 1:1 are marked but only say 'the elder' and do not name John, so they were left out.
Many marked verses only list John among the Twelve or among the companions of Peter, so they were not used.
